stage_family.report_record: stage_test_levels, separate from native accepted history
stage_family.both_targets_unresolved_fallback: at most one RANSWallStageTest=FrozenScalarR2 alpha400 diagnostic with frozen velocity/pressure

physical_acceptance.selected_covariance: all declared finite sets, including exact inner k=0
physical_acceptance.comparison_probe_converged_unqualified_s: preserved with reasons; no native history advance
